crossRefs.note: Now, behold, I know that you will surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hand.
Then Saul said to David, “You are blessed, my son David. You will both do mightily, and will surely prevail.” So David…
Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that Yahweh has blessed me…
His brothers asked him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the…
His master saw that Yahweh was with him, and that Yahweh made all that he did prosper in his hand.
Behold, I give some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Michal
people.line: Daughter of Saul; wife of David.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul saw and knew that Yahweh was with David; and Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved him.
translations.bsb: When Saul realized that the LORD was with David and that his daughter Michal loved David,
translations.kjv: And Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David, and that Michal Saul's daughter loved him.
translations.asv: And Saul saw and knew that Jehovah was with David; and Michal, Saul's daughter, loved him.
